about: A second synthetic person, held out (spec 050): told over ten sessions with a realistic density of messages, then a fresh session with no hints. Frozen on 2026-10-19 before any answer on it was seen. Nothing here is a real person.

messages: Hello! Quick intro since you'll be helping me a lot: I'm Noor, 34, I teach chemistry at a secondary school in Utrecht.
I live with my partner Tomás, he's a sound engineer.
We have two cats, Miso and Ravioli.
Can you suggest a name for a chemistry club? Something fun for 15-year-olds.
I'm learning Japanese, I have lessons on Wednesday evenings.
My goal is to pass the JLPT N4 exam in July.
What's a good way to memorise kanji?
Thanks, I'll try spaced repetition.
One thing for the future: please always give me measurements in metric units, never cups or ounces.
Also, I'm allergic to peanuts, it's serious.
Can you give me a recipe for a quick weeknight curry?
Looks good, thanks.
I told my colleague Pieter I would review his lab safety slides before March 6.
He's the head of the science department.
Can you remind me what the usual sections of a lab safety briefing are?
Great, that helps.
Small correction: Tomás is a lighting engineer, not a sound engineer. I mixed it up because his old job was sound.
We're thinking about adopting a third cat but nothing decided.
What should we consider before adding a third cat?
I sent Pieter my comments on the slides yesterday, so that's done.
My mother's birthday is on March 28, I want to get her a pottery class.
Do you know what usually makes a good beginner pottery class?
Ok, I'll look for one near Amersfoort, that's where she lives.
News: I accepted a job offer! From August I'll teach at an international school in Rotterdam.
We'll move to Rotterdam in July, right after my JLPT exam.
Tomás can keep his job, he works mostly remotely.
Can you help me write a polite resignation email to my current principal, Mrs. de Vries?
From now on, please answer me in English even if I write in Dutch: I want to keep practising for the new school.
Ravioli had a tooth pulled at the vet last week, he's fine now.
Booked the pottery class for my mum, she's excited.
What's a good gift card message for her?
I promised Tomás I'd find a moving company by the end of May.
Also I need to register at the Rotterdam municipality after the move.
My JLPT exam is on July 5.
Any tips for the last months of exam preparation?
We decided not to adopt a third cat after all, two is enough with the move.
I switched my Japanese lessons to Thursday evenings because of a staff meeting.
What's a good stretching routine for someone who sits a lot?
Thanks!
